title: AC-3 (Dolby Digital) signature
summary: An AC-3 file begins with the 16-bit sync word 0x0B77 (0x0B 0x77) at the start of each frame. Each frame is 1536 samples (at 48kHz, ~32ms).
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: Sync word 0x0B77 at the start of each frame.
AC-3 frame: sync (16) + CRC (16) + stream info (bits) + audio blocks (6 blocks of 256 samples) + auxiliary data + CRC.
AC-3 supports up to 5.1 channels (6 channels).
AC-3 is used in DVD, Blu-ray, and digital TV.
